**Key conclusions:**
- **Approved demand** (highest approved revision = r1; r2 forecasts are drafts): 29,000 / 34,000 / 47,000 / 47,000 sets; lifecycle **157,000 sets**.
- **Commercial coverage**: SUP-001 (r2 approved, amendment) and SUP-003 (r2 approved, amendment) bind all years; SUP-002's binding terms are its approved original r1 (its r2 is draft).
- **Technical**: SUP-001 and SUP-002 qualified with no open actions; SUP-003 is **conditional** with `photometry_validation` open.
- **Capacity**: SUP-002 has zero shortfall in all years; SUP-001 and SUP-003 fall short every year.
- **Launch**: SUP-001 (2026-11-16) and SUP-002 (2026-12-07) on time; SUP-003 (2027-02-08) is **38 days late**.
- **Financial (full-award NPV, CNY fen)**: SUP-002 **3,599,636,734** < SUP-003 4,811,400,923 < SUP-001 9,184,966,191.
- **Recommendation: SUP-002** — the only candidate that is admissible, capacity-feasible, on time, and lowest NPV.
